_comment: Authored story + shot list in the shot director's own output format ({ outline, shots }). Original story. Dialogue in Hindi (Devanagari); descriptions in English (they feed image prompts and the action parser). Run: npm run short -- --plan scripts/lab/stories/meera-lost-purse.json --seconds 180

outline.title: Meera and the Lost Purse
outline.logline: A ten-year-old village girl finds a purse full of money and must choose between the bicycle she dreams of and returning it to its owner.

characters.name: Meera
characters.role: a curious, cheerful 10-year-old village girl who dreams of a red bicycle; honest at heart
characters.appearance: a 10-year-old Indian girl, round face, big brown eyes, two long black braids, slim
characters.clothing: bright yellow kurta with green salwar

characters.name: Ramu Kaka
characters.role: a kind elderly farmer who saved all year for his granddaughter Munni's school fees
characters.appearance: an old thin Indian man with grey hair, a white moustache and a kind wrinkled face
characters.clothing: white kurta with a brown shawl

characters.name: Amma
characters.role: Meera's gentle but firm mother who teaches her right from wrong
characters.appearance: a 35-year-old Indian woman with a long black plait, a warm face and a small red bindi
characters.clothing: dark blue saree with an orange border

locations.name: Village lane
locations.look: a dusty Indian village lane with mud-brick houses, blue painted wooden doors and a huge banyan tree with hanging roots
locations.lighting: soft warm morning sunlight with long shadows

locations.name: Meera's courtyard
locations.look: the open courtyard of a small Indian village house: whitewashed mud walls, a tulsi plant on a pedestal, a woven charpai cot, clay pots
locations.lighting: bright warm morning sun and soft shade

locations.name: Village square
locations.look: an Indian village square with an old stone well, a small tea stall and a large peepal tree on dusty ground
locations.lighting: bright midday sun with hard shadows

shots.action: Morning sun over a quiet dusty village lane with mud houses and a huge banyan tree.

line.speaker: narrator
line.text: सूरजपुर गाँव में सुबह की धूप फैल रही थी, और हर कोई अपने काम में लगा था।

shots.action: Meera walks down the lane swinging her arms, on her way to the market.

line.speaker: narrator
line.text: दस साल की मीरा अपनी माँ के लिए सब्ज़ी लेने बाज़ार जा रही थी।

shots.action: Meera stops and looks down at something red lying in the dust under the banyan tree.

line.speaker: meera
line.text: अरे! ये लाल-लाल क्या पड़ा है मिट्टी में?

shots.action: A red cloth purse lies in the dust between the roots of the banyan tree.
Meera bends down and picks up the red cloth purse.

line.speaker: meera
line.text: किसी का बटुआ गिर गया है। अरे, ये तो काफ़ी भारी भी है।

shots.action: Inside the open red cloth purse: a thick bundle of rupee notes and a few coins.

line.speaker: narrator
line.text: बटुए में नोटों की मोटी गड्डी थी। इतने पैसे मीरा ने पहले कभी नहीं देखे थे।

shots.action: Meera's eyes go wide as she stares at the money.

line.speaker: meera
line.text: इतने सारे पैसे! ये तो हज़ारों रुपये होंगे!

shots.action: Meera looks left and right along the empty lane; nobody is there.

line.speaker: meera
line.text: यहाँ तो कोई भी नहीं है। किसका हो सकता है ये?

shots.action: Meera holds the red cloth purse to her chest and thinks of the red bicycle in the shop.

line.speaker: narrator
line.text: मीरा को याद आया, बाज़ार की दुकान में एक लाल साइकिल है, जिसका वो रोज़ सपना देखती है।

shots.action: Meera smiles dreamily, imagining herself riding a new bicycle.

line.speaker: meera
line.text: इन पैसों से तो मेरी साइकिल आ जाएगी... और एक नई गुड़िया भी!

shots.action: Meera hides the red cloth purse behind her back and runs home.

line.speaker: narrator
line.text: उसने बटुआ पीठ के पीछे छिपाया और तेज़ी से घर की ओर भाग गई।

shots.action: A small courtyard of a village house with a tulsi plant, a charpai and clay pots in morning light.
Amma sweeps the courtyard and looks up in surprise.

line.speaker: amma
line.text: मीरा? इतनी जल्दी लौट आई? सब्ज़ी कहाँ है, बेटा?

shots.action: Meera stands stiffly, hiding something behind her back.
Amma tilts her head kindly, noticing the hidden hand.

line.speaker: amma
line.text: पीछे क्या छिपा रही हो? सच-सच बताओ, मीरा।

shots.action: Meera slowly brings the red cloth purse out and holds it up.

line.speaker: meera
line.text: माँ, रास्ते में ये बटुआ मिला। इसमें बहुत सारे पैसे हैं।

shots.action: Amma looks at the purse, then at Meera, serious.

line.speaker: amma
line.text: ये पैसे किसी की मेहनत की कमाई हैं। सोचो, उस पर क्या बीत रही होगी।

shots.action: Meera frowns and argues, clutching the purse.

line.speaker: meera
line.text: पर माँ, ये मुझे मिला है। जो मिल जाए, वो अपना होता है ना?

shots.action: Amma sits on the charpai and gently gestures for Meera to sit beside her.

line.speaker: amma
line.text: नहीं बेटा। जो चीज़ हमारी नहीं, उस पर हमारा कोई हक़ नहीं होता।

shots.action: Amma speaks softly, her eyes warm.

line.speaker: amma
line.text: अगर तुम्हारी गुल्लक खो जाए, तो तुम्हें कैसा लगेगा?

shots.action: Meera looks down at the purse, her lips trembling.

line.speaker: meera
line.text: मैं तो रो-रोकर बुरा हाल कर लूँगी...

shots.action: A small worn slip of paper tucked in the red cloth purse with a name written in pencil.

line.speaker: narrator
line.text: बटुए की तह में एक पुरानी पर्ची थी, जिस पर लिखा था — रामू।

shots.action: Meera looks up with sudden understanding.

line.speaker: meera
line.text: रामू काका! ये ज़रूर चौपाल वाले रामू काका का है!

shots.action: Amma smiles and nods, proud of her daughter.

line.speaker: amma
line.text: तो देर किस बात की? जाओ, अभी उन्हें लौटा आओ।

shots.action: The village square with an old stone well, a tea stall and a big peepal tree in the midday sun.

line.speaker: narrator
line.text: उधर चौपाल पर रामू काका परेशान होकर इधर-उधर कुछ ढूँढ रहे थे।

shots.action: Ramu Kaka walks around the well searching the ground, bent over.

line.speaker: ramu-kaka
line.text: हे भगवान! कहाँ गिर गया मेरा बटुआ?

shots.action: Ramu Kaka wipes his forehead, close to tears.

line.speaker: ramu-kaka
line.text: उसमें मुन्नी की स्कूल की फ़ीस थी... पूरे साल की बचत।

shots.action: Meera runs down the lane toward the square, holding the red cloth purse.

line.speaker: narrator
line.text: मीरा दौड़ती हुई चौपाल की ओर चल पड़ी।

shots.action: Meera reaches the edge of the square and stops, hesitating, gripping the purse.

line.speaker: narrator
line.text: पर चौपाल पहुँचकर उसके कदम एक पल के लिए रुक गए। लाल साइकिल फिर याद आई।

shots.action: Meera takes a deep breath and decides.

line.speaker: meera
line.text: नहीं। माँ ठीक कहती हैं। ये मेरा नहीं है।

shots.action: Meera walks up to Ramu Kaka and holds out the red cloth purse.

line.speaker: meera
line.text: काका, ये आपका बटुआ है? बरगद के नीचे मिट्टी में पड़ा था।

shots.action: Ramu Kaka turns, stunned, and stares at the purse.

line.speaker: ramu-kaka
line.text: मेरा बटुआ! बेटी, तुमने तो मेरी जान बचा ली!

shots.action: Ramu Kaka holds the red cloth purse to his chest and offers Meera a banknote as a reward.

line.speaker: ramu-kaka
line.text: लो बेटी, ये इनाम रख लो। अपनी साइकिल ले लेना।

shots.action: Meera smiles and shakes her head politely.

line.speaker: meera
line.text: नहीं काका। मुन्नी की पढ़ाई ज़्यादा ज़रूरी है। बस आशीर्वाद दीजिए।

shots.action: Ramu Kaka raises his hand in blessing, eyes shining.

line.speaker: ramu-kaka
line.text: जीती रहो बेटी। तुम जैसी ईमानदार बच्ची पर पूरे गाँव को गर्व है।

shots.action: Meera skips back into the courtyard, beaming.

line.speaker: narrator
line.text: उस दिन मीरा को साइकिल नहीं मिली, पर उसे कुछ उससे भी बड़ा मिला — सबका भरोसा।

shots.action: The banyan tree in the lane sways in a warm breeze.

line.speaker: narrator
line.text: सच ही कहते हैं — ईमानदारी सबसे बड़ा धन है।
